featured_reviews.name: Harsh Parte
featured_reviews.review_text:
Had an excellent experience at Sir H. N. Reliance Foundation Hospital and Research Centre during my father’s bypass surgery treatment. Special thanks to Dr. Neeraj Kamat and his entire team for their exceptional treatment, guidance, and compassionate care throughout the journey. Their professionalism and support gave our family great confidence during a difficult time.

A heartfelt appreciation to the nursing staff, especially Nancy Dsouza, Akash, Nikita, and Deepali, for being extremely supportive, attentive, and caring at every step. Their kindness and dedication provided great comfort during the hospital stay.

Special thanks as well to the cleaning staff, especially Pawan Kumar and Barsa, for maintaining excellent hygiene and cleanliness and for their prompt support whenever needed.

One area where improvement is needed is visitor management and security coordination. The hospital has multiple levels of security checks — at the entrance, ground floor lift lobby, inside the lift area, and again on the patient floor. While security and patient safety are important, the process currently feels too strict and time-consuming for visitors. Visitor timings are already limited, and due to repeated checks and delays, a significant part of the allowed visiting time gets consumed. The hospital management may consider streamlining the process to make the visitor experience smoother while still maintaining safety standards.

Overall, highly thankful to the entire hospital team for their outstanding service and patient care.

Thanks,
From Bed No -1713

My father passed away on 18th April, and despite several follow-ups, this hospital has still not submitted the required documents to the BMC for the death certificate process. At a time when a grieving family is already under immense emotional stress, the complete lack of urgency, empathy, and basic decency shown by the staff has been deeply disturbing.

What made the experience even worse was the sheer negligence of the staff. On the very next day after the passing, we had to revisit the hospital because the team had forgotten to take a required signature. Such basic procedural lapses during such a sensitive time are simply unacceptable.

The entire case was handled in an extremely disappointing manner, and the communication with the family of a deceased patient was insensitive and unprofessional throughout. Instead of supporting us during an already painful situation, the hospital added unnecessary emotional trauma, frustration, and repeated inconvenience.

I strongly urge people to think twice before opting for services here. Compassion, accountability, professionalism, and timely administrative support are the bare minimum expected from any hospital, and unfortunately, we experienced none of these.
